method.supportInterpretation: Current whole-system mass-weighted COM x and observed ground contact x span are a static necessary clue, not a sufficient dynamic stability criterion.
method.separationUnits: Creator 3.8.8 box2d-wasm/physics-contact.ts lines130-145 reads native manifold pointCount, truncates points/separations to that count, and multiplies both by PTM_RATIO=32. Recorded separations therefore use Cocos world units, not metres.
method.boundary: These fixtures exclude the normal claw/camera placement height and incident rules. They do not estimate normal demo survival rate.
